subject: Apology for meeting mix-up
text: Hello, I wanted to apologize for the confusion around today’s meeting. Because my train was delayed earlier, I joined late and may have misunderstood the time you suggested. I realize that caused an unnecessary inconvenience, and I am sorry for not confirming the schedule sooner. Thank you for being understanding while the plans changed. I will review the calendar again before proposing a new time. Please let me know when a better moment works for you.
